module.name: app:views/app/dev-system/blueprint-workspace/blueprint-workspace-dataview

OptionalFormFields.name: OptionalFormFields
OptionalFormFields.jsdoc: Permission-filtered form projection; unreadable wire members are absent.

BlueprintChildNodeCreate.name: BlueprintChildNodeCreate
BlueprintChildNodeCreate.jsdoc: Stable row identity and wire fields for one preflighted leaf.

attributes.name: nodeId
attributes.jsdoc: Stable explicit row identity, unique within the current project and this command.

attributes.name: fields
attributes.jsdoc: Candidate formal wire fields; the current DataView validates every field before staging.

BlueprintChildNodeCreateAtParent.name: BlueprintChildNodeCreateAtParent
BlueprintChildNodeCreateAtParent.jsdoc: A preflighted leaf row whose parent is an existing row in the current DataView.

BlueprintNodeDataBatchItem.name: BlueprintNodeDataBatchItem
BlueprintNodeDataBatchItem.jsdoc: Fully preflighted target identity and patch, ready for synchronous overlay staging.

BlueprintLeafMoveBatchCommand.name: BlueprintLeafMoveBatchCommand
BlueprintLeafMoveBatchCommand.jsdoc: Explicit pure move/reorder command emitted by the project-planning diff.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.jsdoc: `move` reparents an existing leaf; `reorder` changes only an existing sibling's formal order.

attributes.name: nodeId
attributes.jsdoc: Existing rowid from the complete original project tree.

attributes.name: parentNodeId
attributes.jsdoc: Parent identity in the target tree; must also exist in the original same-project tree.

attributes.name: previousParentNodeId
attributes.jsdoc: Original parent identity captured by the replacement plan.

attributes.name: depth
attributes.jsdoc: Target depth and sibling position from the explicit replacement plan.

attributes.name: fields
attributes.jsdoc: Exact formal wire fields for this command; only `prowid` and `FunOrderValue` are accepted.

BlueprintLeafMoveBatchOptions.name: BlueprintLeafMoveBatchOptions
BlueprintLeafMoveBatchOptions.jsdoc: Named inputs for one preflighted AI move/reorder batch.

attributes.name: beforeTree
attributes.jsdoc: Complete original tree used by the planner.

attributes.name: commands
attributes.jsdoc: Explicit wire move/reorder commands from the plan.

attributes.name: expectedTree
attributes.jsdoc: Complete target tree represented by those commands.

methods.name: beforeStage
methods.jsdoc: Called after owner preflight and immediately before staging.

BlueprintWorkspaceDataView.name: BlueprintWorkspaceDataView
BlueprintWorkspaceDataView.jsdoc: 一个已查询目标的 DataView 编辑入口；正式元数据和查询权限均由原 DataSpace owner 提供。

constructorMeta.signatureText: constructor(dataSet: DataSet, projectId: string, assertCurrent: () => void)

attributes.name: hasPendingBlueprintCommand
attributes.jsdoc: Keep the owner mounted while a write receipt or its required readback is unresolved.

methods.name: loadProjectTree
methods.jsdoc: Load the displayed tree through the same bound DataView owner used by edits.

methods.name: removeLeafNode
methods.jsdoc: Delete one ordinary leaf through the current project tree DataView and confirm it by readback.

methods.name: moveNode
methods.jsdoc: Temporarily widens this same DataView to project rows and stages a permission-checked move.

methods.name: applyLeafMoveBatch
methods.jsdoc: Preflight, stage and save one AI pure leaf-move/reorder command through this DataView.

methods.name: addRootModule
methods.jsdoc: Create an unmounted root module through the current formal Base_NavigationInfo query owner.

methods.name: addChildNodes
methods.jsdoc: Preflight and submit several stable leaf IDs under one existing parent in one DataSet batch.

methods.name: addChildNodesAcrossParents
methods.jsdoc: Preflight and submit stable leaf IDs under multiple existing parents in one DataSet batch.

methods.name: addAndUpdateChildNodes
methods.jsdoc: Preflight, stage, and save creates plus existing leaf updates as one DataSet view batch.

methods.name: nodeData
methods.jsdoc: Read the selected editable node as a permission-filtered compatibility projection.

methods.name: preflightNodeData
methods.jsdoc: Validate a domain projection without writing, so multi-owner commands can preflight before creating files.

methods.name: updateNodeData
methods.jsdoc: Apply a domain projection by diffing through the canonical wire mapper and preflighting every changed field.

methods.name: preflightNodeDataBatch
methods.jsdoc: Preflight every requested existing node before applying any edit overlay.

methods.name: updateNodeDataBatch
methods.jsdoc: Stage preflighted existing-node updates on their formal DataView row identities.

methods.name: saveNodes
methods.jsdoc: Save exactly the requested preflighted rows through this DataSet and verify every changed field.

methods.name: treeProjection
methods.jsdoc: Build the display tree strictly from the current DataView rows and their edit overlays.

methods.name: cancel
methods.jsdoc: 丢弃 DataView 编辑覆盖或已暂存行修改；没有页面副本需要清空。

methods.name: saveSelectedNode
methods.jsdoc: Save only the selected node; any staged changes on other rows remain untouched.
